sql: select 'fitness_rows' as k, c.number::text as a, count(*)::text as b, ''::text as c from evo_fitness f join evo_cohorts c on c.id=f.cohort_id group by 1,2 union all select 'listeners', status, count(*)::text, '' from evo_listeners group by 1,2 union all select 'influences_alltime','', count(*)::text, max(created_at)::text from evo_influences union all select 'heartbeats_7d', kind||'/'||status, count(*)::text, '' from evo_heartbeats where created_at > now() - interval '7 days' group by 1,2 union all select 'orders_by_status', status, count(*)::text, min(created_at)::text from evo_orders group by 1,2 union all select 'strategies', status, count(*)::text, '' from evo_strategies group by 1,2 union all select 'sandbox_runs_7d','', count(*)::text,'' from evo_sandbox_runs where created_at > now() - interval '7 days' order by 1,2
